important.body: AWG stores typed graph objects in append-only JSONL logs, then deterministically compiles them into graph JSON, diagnostics, agent lenses, human review views, and a static HTML viewer. V1 is intentionally offline and file-backed: no server, daemon, database, telemetry, hosted sync, vector search, LLM calls, MCP, or automatic cross-project context injection.
important.summary: AWG is a local-first Agent Work Graph CLI and file format for durable agent knowledge, using project-local .awg vaults as canonical storage.
important.title: AWG project purpose

important.body: src/cli/index.ts dispatches commands. add supports node/edge/response. build/validate/doctor/lens/view wrap compiler outputs. open prints or launches static viewer files and supports --global/--no-launch. setup/register/vault manage the global registry. instructions installs managed agent snippets. upgrade updates project vault scaffolding and instruction blocks.
important.summary: The CLI exposes setup, upgrade, init, register/unregister, vault, instructions, add, build, validate, doctor, lens, view, and open commands.
important.title: CLI command surface

important.body: src/core/compiler.ts is the center of the runtime. It uses storage.readConfig/readSchemas/readLogEntries, parseAndValidate, last-write-wins node merging, deterministic sorting, generated_at derived from source timestamps, buildDiagnostics, buildResumeLens, buildCurrentView, and renderStaticSite. Fatal builds still refresh graph and failure diagnostics/viewer artifacts.
important.summary: buildAwg reads config/schemas/log entries, validates JSONL, materializes current graph state, runs diagnostics, then writes deterministic compiled artifacts.
important.title: Compiler architecture

important.body: As of the AWG install pass, git status showed untracked .awg/, AGENTS.md, and CLAUDE.md. main and origin/main were synced at de1606a before adding the project AWG vault. The vault initially built clean with 0 nodes/edges before this context population.
important.summary: The AWG repo now has a project-local .awg vault, root AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, and global registration; these files are currently untracked until committed.

important.body: Current checks include malformed JSON, schema errors, incompatible duplicate IDs, dangling edges, orphan nodes, duplicate-looking aliases, stale review dates, completed tasks without evidence, unanswered questions, low-confidence active nodes, blocked-by-resolved, and implemented-proposed decisions. --strict elevates warnings to fatal.
important.summary: Diagnostics distinguish fatal validation/build errors from warnings and drive doctor, lens, and viewer health output.
important.title: Diagnostic model

important.body: src/storage/FileAwgStorage.ts locates the nearest plausible project .awg vault, reads config/schema/log entries, appends log entries to today’s JSONL file, and writes compiled artifacts. It excludes compiled files from canonical input and expects log files to match the YYYY/MM/YYYY-MM-DD.awg.jsonl pattern.
important.summary: FileAwgStorage is the current storage backend and should remain the canonical V1 adapter unless a future slice explicitly adds more.
important.title: File storage adapter

important.body: setup/register/vault/open global flows use ~/.awg/config.json and ~/.awg/registry.json to remember known project vaults. Registry entries identify vault path/name/scope/timestamps/tags/favorite and preserve unknown fields for forward compatibility. Registering updates lastSeenAt and avoids duplicates by canonical vault path.
important.summary: ~/.awg stores config, registry, and switcher output only; it is not a global merged graph.
important.title: Global registry model

important.body: Codex patches an existing AGENTS.md/agents.md or creates AGENTS.md. Claude Code patches existing CLAUDE.md/claude.md or writes .awg/instructions/claude-code.md. Antigravity writes .awg/instructions/antigravity.md. Dry-run reports intended files. Installs are idempotent and preserve unrelated content.

evidence.summary: npm run typecheck, npm test, git diff --check, and two subagent re-review passes completed after fixing malformed-marker, hash-owner, and upgrade-preflight findings.

important.summary: Instruction installs and upgrades patch only AWG-owned managed blocks in AGENTS.md/agents.md and CLAUDE.md/claude.md. Managed blocks carry pack ownership plus a body hash, edited or malformed blocks fail closed, --force replaces only a valid managed block, and upgrade preflights instruction conflicts before vault writes.
important.title: Instruction installation behavior

important.body: The project deliberately keeps project/.awg as the source of truth. ~/.awg is only a registry/control-plane directory, not a merged knowledge base. Cross-vault references must be explicit and registered vaults must not be automatically injected into project lenses.
important.summary: Keep AWG local, deterministic, and file-backed; do not add daemon/server/database/hosted-sync/MCP/vector-search/LLM creep without an explicit later slice.
important.title: Local-first scope boundary

recent_responses.summary: Subagent review loop completed for the V1.3 human surface framework. Valid findings fixed: mobile media CSS, needs-attention and open decision/question drilldowns, missing graph focus handling, symlink-safe compiled reads/open behavior, generated viewer parity, and regression tests. Remaining architecture notes are intentionally deferred: stricter view block schema contracts, deeper source/runtime helper unification, and splitting monolithic viewer assets before adding many more themes.
Removed secondary labels from overview section headers, including subtitles and the item/count label, and compacted the header height to match the simpler structure.

Changed overview review rows to use globally synchronized dynamic metadata columns: fixed marker column, flexible title column, and measured status/type/score/health/tag columns that shrink to content while staying aligned across all overview sections.
Adjusted overview review row marker spacing so status dots sit evenly between the left row edge and the row text.
Shortened the visible needs_review status label to 'review' in viewer badges and centered overview status badges inside their fixed row column.
Removed Resume Lens Preview from the overview route because its useful data is already transformed into curated overview sections; the lens remains available through the Views route.

Aligned overview review row metadata into fixed status/type/score/health/tag columns, matched row markers to status badge colors, and applied the same overview surface treatment to Recently Completed and Resume Lens Preview blocks.

Reworked overview review blocks to use full-width inspection sections with header counts, dense clickable rows, status markers, compact metadata, human-readable status labels, and responsive row behavior instead of generic stacked node cards.

Added overview UI demo nodes for Attention Required, Open Decisions, Active Risks, and Open Questions, with representative statuses and relationships so the generated current view renders populated review sections.
Made the graph canvas fill the graph card body by removing the inner canvas padding, border, and radius while keeping toolbar and footer attached to the same surface.
